messages:
maya: quick sync 9 need to lock DP recruitment + acceptance criteria before sprint plan. Target: 8 partners, two 2-week pilots, measurable go/no-go.

anton: 👍 do we have a no-double-invite list vs private beta? want to avoid overlap.

linh: I can own scoping workshops (30m). will capture must-have vs nice-to-have and a final scope doc. reuse: tiny.redwood/scoping-template

ravi: flag: customers asking for KMS/HSM access. legal + security review needed; this can add ~2w. will start SOW draft.

maya: draft acceptance checklist:
- SDK + sample app running in partner env
- 2 end-to-end flows exercised
- quality regression <= 2% on core prompt set
- weekly synth-evals + tickets triaged within 48h
- partner commit: ~8-16 eng hrs/week
agree?

samir: infra notes: reserve demo burst (200 rps) and define fallback policy. if dedicated capacity unavailable, auto-route to compatible smaller model and surface degraded flag to partner. also expose observability dashboard link.

anton: for prioritizing asks during pilot propose scorecard: Impact (1-5) * Urgency (1-5) * Feasibility (1-5). i'll make a sheet.

linh: recruiting DM (short):
"Hi — Redwood running a 2-week inference pilot. We provide capacity, eng support, and tailored metrics. Looking for teams with a live flow, ~8-12 hrs/wk availability, and weekly feedback sessions. Interested?"

ravi: @maya please loop legal & security for HSM gating. i'll prepare a one-page SOW addendum.

maya: owners: anton=outreach+scorecard, samir=infra+fallback+dashboards, linh=scoping+ops-runbook, ravi=legal/SOW. milestones: outreach + SOW draft by Tue EOD; scoping workshops within 5bd; first cohort onboarded by month-end.

ops-bot: Calendar: provisional event "DP Scoping Workshops" created for next Wed 10:00-12:00. invites sent to owners.

maya: i'll compile outreach copy + acceptance checklist tomorrow and circulate for signoff. target partner signoffs + countersigned SOWs by Fri. :rocket:
